dogecoin.text:
A tweet from Musk could drive the price of $DOGE higher. A shout out on SNL would've shot price up to $1, but instead it dumped.

I guess it's a case of sell the news, buy the rumor.

In the last 3 days. $MATIC has rallied a %100 to hit an ATH of $1.8. While $DOGE rallied 68% to hit a high of $0.59.

How come no one's talking about $MATIC, all we hear of is $DOGE. Like it's only $DOGE that going to the moon😂

Barry Silbert said $DOGE wouldn't cross $1 in May when he shorted $DOGE after Elon Musk SNL. Then $DOGE was trading at $0.72. It closed May at $0.32.

Don't want to believe these are just mere coincidence.

#Crypto #DogeCoinTo1Dollar
